annotations.title: Earnings move: priced against past reactions

description: The move the options market prices for a company's next results beside the moves its shares made after its past ones, no key: the next release estimated from a year earlier, the at-the-money straddle of the first expiration after it (Cboe), the results' own move backed out of the expirations either side, and each of the last eight releases' reaction close to close, with the average and how many moved more than priced now.

releases.description: Past results releases measured, latest first; default 8.

name: earnings_move

outputSchema.description: implied_move is the straddle of the first expiration after the expected results; results_alone the results' own move; past_moves each release's reaction in the order of its columns.

title: Earnings move: priced against past reactions
